summary.text: Walker Thomas is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 8 who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was previously elected to the Hopkinsville City Council.

paragraphs.text: Walker Thomas was born in Hopkinsville, Kentucky, and earned a bachelor of business administration from Austin Peay State University.
His career experience includes working with Kentucky Moving and Storage and serving as president and assistant governor with the Rotary Club.
He has been a member of the Salvation Army and the Military Affairs Committee and was elected to the Hopkinsville City Council.
Thomas took office in the Kentucky House in 2017.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture Committee, the Appropriations and Revenue Committee, the Transportation Committee, and the Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection Committee.
